title: Semantic Kernel vs Agent Framework vs Microsoft.Extensions.AI

cues.en: Hi and welcome to this AI in C# video where we'll be covering the different options you have to use LLMs in C# in 2025.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎觀看這支 C# AI 教學影片。我們會介紹在 2025 年，使用 C# 操作 LLM 有哪些選擇。

cues.en: So we'll be covering Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Extensions AI and the newest addition, Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 我們會介紹 Semantic Kernel、Microsoft.Extensions.AI，以及最新加入的 Microsoft Agent Framework。

cues.en: So let's quickly have a look at the three.
cues.zh: 先快速看看這三個框架。

cues.en: Semantic Kernel is the oldest, releasing back in March 2023 and then came along in 2024
cues.zh: Semantic Kernel 最早，在 2023 年 3 月推出。接著是 2024 年的

cues.en: October, Microsoft Extensions AI and now in October 2025 we now have the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 10 月推出 Microsoft.Extensions.AI，現在則在 2025 年 10 月迎來 Microsoft Agent Framework。

cues.en: All of them else are exactly the same, it's the Microsoft that are maintainer of all of the three.
cues.zh: 除此之外，它們都一樣：三者都是由 Microsoft 維護。

cues.en: Two of them, Semantic Kernel and Microsoft Agent Framework being the same team while Microsoft Extensions AI is the .NET team.
cues.zh: 其中 Semantic Kernel 與 Microsoft Agent Framework 由同一個團隊負責，Microsoft.Extensions.AI 則由 .NET 團隊負責。

cues.en: Else they're all free, they're all MIT licences and they're all released as NuGet packages.
cues.zh: 三者也都免費，採用 MIT 授權，並以 NuGet 套件發布。

cues.en: So let's do some side-by-side comparison of them.
cues.zh: 接著把它們並排比較一下。

cues.en: First up we just have chat.
cues.zh: 首先是最基本的對話功能。

cues.en: In Semantic Kernel you needed to make something called a kernel builder and add a kind of mini dependency injection which was a little
cues.zh: 在 Semantic Kernel 中，需要建立 Kernel Builder，再加入一套小型相依性注入機制。這有點

cues.en: funky but it worked.
cues.zh: 奇特，但確實能運作。

cues.en: Then you made a chat completion agent where you could give your instructions to the agent, the system instructions.
cues.zh: 接著建立 ChatCompletionAgent，在裡面提供代理程式的指示，也就是系統指示。

cues.en: And then you did an invoke async on your question and for some reason it was for each back, not needed really but that
cues.zh: 然後針對問題呼叫 InvokeAsync。不知為何，取得結果還得用 foreach；其實沒有必要，但

cues.en: was the way it was done.
cues.zh: 它就是這樣設計的。

cues.en: Extensions AI is a more low-level system so it doesn't have the concept of agents and for that reason it needs to just
cues.zh: Extensions.AI 是更底層的系統，沒有代理程式的概念，因此需要直接

cues.en: make a raw client to whatever you use, in this case Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 建立你所使用服務的原生用戶端，這個例子是 Azure OpenAI。

cues.en: And then it turns it into an iChat client that can be used to do this.
cues.zh: 接著將它轉成可使用的 IChatClient。

cues.en: And the response is fairly concise but if you need system messages or instructions it's always
cues.zh: 取得回應的寫法相當精簡，但如果需要系統訊息或指示，就必須

cues.en: something you need to put into the individual response which is kind of low-level and to me one of the most annoying things
cues.zh: 在每一次個別請求中自行放入。這相當底層，也是我覺得 Extensions.AI 最惱人的

cues.en: about Extensions AI.
cues.zh: 地方之一。

cues.en: But else it's a very concise system.
cues.zh: 不過除此之外，它是個非常精簡的系統。

cues.en: Microsoft's agent framework takes the best of both worlds.
cues.zh: Microsoft Agent Framework 則結合了兩者的優點。

cues.en: It still does the same as Extensions AI by newing up the raw client but instead of as an iChat client it says create
cues.zh: 它一樣會像 Extensions.AI 那樣，先建立原生用戶端，但不是轉成 IChatClient，而是呼叫 CreateAIAgent，

cues.en: AI agents.
cues.zh: 建立 AI 代理程式。

cues.en: And here you can directly give the instructions and they are kept so they will be sent with every call to the agent.
cues.zh: 你可以直接在這裡提供指示，框架會保留它們，因此每次呼叫代理程式時都會一起送出。

cues.en: So you just make a run async and get your response back which is more or less the same as the chat response.
cues.zh: 接著只要呼叫 RunAsync 就能取得回應，和一般的對話回應差不多。

cues.en: In general these two are very much alike but with the agent on top it makes agent framework more easy in my opinion.
cues.zh: 整體而言，這兩者很相似，但加上代理程式這一層後，我認為 Agent Framework 更容易使用。

cues.en: When it comes to tool calling they can all do that.
cues.zh: 至於工具呼叫，三者都做得到。

cues.en: Semantic kernel need to have special classes that are decorated with a kernel function.
cues.zh: Semantic Kernel 需要建立特定類別，並以 KernelFunction 屬性標記方法。

cues.en: And then we do the same stuff again but on the kernel we import the plugin as they call them into the kernel.
cues.zh: 之後的步驟類似，但要將它們所稱的外掛匯入 Kernel。

cues.en: And then when we do the agent we need to tell it with a bunch of kernel arguments and Azure AI prompts here that it's allowed to call them else it won't
cues.zh: 建立代理程式時，還必須透過一組 KernelArguments 與這裡的 Azure AI 提示詞設定，告訴它可以呼叫工具，否則它

cues.en: call them.
cues.zh: 就不會呼叫。

cues.en: And then you just do the normal loop for chat and you use the tool.
cues.zh: 接著執行一般的對話迴圈，就能使用工具。

cues.en: Extensions AI uses delicate methods for tools so you can either just assign them using an
cues.zh: Extensions.AI 使用委派方法作為工具，因此可以直接透過這裡的

cues.en: AI function create here or you can do use some reflection to find all your functions in a class.
cues.zh: AIFunctionFactory.Create 指定，也可以用反射找出類別中的所有函式。

cues.en: Again we need to have the system message out by itself so but beyond that it is very simple and we don't need to tell that it's allowed to call them they
cues.zh: 同樣地，系統訊息必須另外處理。但除此之外非常簡單，也不必另外告訴它允許呼叫工具，因為

cues.en: are auto tool calling by default.
cues.zh: 預設就會自動呼叫工具。

cues.en: Agent framework is exactly the same but whenever you create your agent you can tell which tools that agent have available.
cues.zh: Agent Framework 的方式完全相同，但可以在建立代理程式時，指定該代理程式可以使用哪些工具。

cues.en: Down here you needed to tell what tools you wanted to use for each individual call.
cues.zh: 下面這種寫法，必須在每次個別呼叫時指定要使用的工具。

cues.en: Here you can define all the calls on the agent and just make your different calls.
cues.zh: 這裡則可以把所有工具定義在代理程式上，再進行各種呼叫。

cues.en: But beyond that they are very much the same they're using the same way of defining tools so a little more easy because of
cues.zh: 除此之外，兩者非常相似，定義工具的方式也相同。因為多了代理程式，所以稍微容易一些，

cues.en: the agents but nothing more than that.
cues.zh: 差別就只有這樣。

cues.en: When it comes to unstructured outputs they all use some kind of output object in this case a person.
cues.zh: 接著看結構化輸出。它們都會使用某種輸出物件，這裡以 Person 為例。

cues.en: Semantic kernel needs to on the agent say that that agent should always give a response format of the type of the person in
cues.zh: 在 Semantic Kernel 中，必須設定代理程式，讓它每次都以這裡的 Person 型別作為回應格式，

cues.en: this case and then normally call and the message back here would be a JSON string that you then need to deserialize.
cues.zh: 接著正常呼叫。這裡取得的訊息會是 JSON 字串，還需要自己反序列化。

cues.en: Extension AI make it much easier in that you have a generic method of the call to the LLM where you just give the
cues.zh: Extensions.AI 則簡單許多。呼叫 LLM 的方法有泛型版本，只要指定

cues.en: object that you want back and then you get that back as a response so you get your object so you don't need to tell anything what type it is that happens
cues.zh: 想取得的物件型別，回應就會直接給你該物件。不必再另外設定輸出型別，因為這已經在呼叫時

cues.en: in the call and you don't need to deserialize yourself.
cues.zh: 指定，也不必自己反序列化。

cues.en: Agent framework does the same but of course again have the agent part and it needs to do a run async instead of a
cues.zh: Agent Framework 的做法相同，當然也多了代理程式這一層，而且要呼叫 RunAsync，而不是

cues.en: get response async but else they are exactly the same.
cues.zh: GetResponseAsync。除此之外完全一樣。

cues.en: There is certain type of agents that can't do this meaning the chat client agents are the only ones that can do it but
cues.zh: 有些代理程式無法這樣做。目前只有 ChatClientAgent 能使用這種方式，

cues.en: they have some more advanced agents that are not allowed to use structured output.
cues.zh: 某些更進階的代理程式則不支援結構化輸出。

cues.en: Other concepts well if we do a little side-by-side comparison the number of new gets you need in order to do hello world is two in each one of them.
cues.zh: 再看其他概念。把它們並排比較，要完成 Hello World，三者各需要兩個 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: You can see the names here.
cues.zh: 你可以在這裡看到套件名稱。

cues.en: Embeddings.
cues.zh: 接著是嵌入向量。

cues.en: Microsoft Extension AI is the only one who have embeddings.
cues.zh: 只有 Microsoft.Extensions.AI 本身提供嵌入向量功能。

cues.en: The two others leverage them.
cues.zh: 另外兩個框架會利用它來完成這項工作。

cues.en: Semantic kernel had an old one but I haven't listed it here because nowadays if you use semantic kernel you just leverage Microsoft Extension AI.
cues.zh: Semantic Kernel 曾經有自己的舊版實作，但我沒有列在這裡，因為現在使用 Semantic Kernel 時，通常會直接使用 Microsoft.Extensions.AI。

cues.en: Agents semantic kernel and agent framework have that concept while extensions AI being a more low -level system you need to more control your
cues.zh: 代理程式方面，Semantic Kernel 與 Agent Framework 都有這個概念。Extensions.AI 則是更底層的系統，因此需要自行管理

cues.en: own system messages and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 系統訊息之類的內容。

cues.en: So everything happens on each individual call instead of defining everything on an agent and then working from there.
cues.zh: 也就是說，所有設定都在每一次個別呼叫中處理，而不是先在代理程式上定義好，再以它為基礎工作。

cues.en: Workflows.
cues.zh: 接著是工作流程。

cues.en: Semantic kernel have a workflow they call it process framework and agent framework of course have the workflows.
cues.zh: Semantic Kernel 有工作流程功能，稱為 Process Framework；Agent Framework 當然也有 Workflows。

cues.en: Extensions AI don't have that concept so you can't leverage that.
cues.zh: Extensions.AI 沒有這個概念，因此無法直接使用這項功能。

cues.en: Agentic workflows is something agent framework have picked up from their other team called Autogen and
cues.zh: 代理式工作流程則是 Agent Framework 從另一個名為 AutoGen 的團隊吸收進來的功能，

cues.en: that's now in the agent framework.
cues.zh: 現在已整合進 Agent Framework。

cues.en: It wasn't really in the semantic kernel and again Microsoft Extensions AI don't have any concept of this.
cues.zh: Semantic Kernel 並沒有真正提供這項功能；同樣地，Microsoft.Extensions.AI 也沒有這個概念。

cues.en: Vector stores is something neither extensions AI or agent framework have.
cues.zh: 向量儲存區則是 Extensions.AI 與 Agent Framework 都沒有的功能。

cues.en: They have the embeddings but they don't have anything to actually put it up into a vector store like Azure AI search or into
cues.zh: 它們可以產生嵌入向量，但沒有提供把資料存入 Azure AI Search 這類向量儲存區，或是

cues.en: a SQL server or something like that.
cues.zh: SQL Server 等系統的功能。

cues.en: For that something called Microsoft Extensions vector data exists.
cues.zh: 為此，有一套名為 Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData 的套件。

cues.en: It's a NuGet package and that NuGet package actually lives inside semantic kernel.
cues.zh: 它是一個 NuGet 套件，而目前這個套件實際放在 Semantic Kernel 儲存庫裡。

cues.en: At some point semantic kernel need to pull it out because it's not really semantic kernel that have the support for vector stores.
cues.zh: Semantic Kernel 終究應該把它獨立出去，因為支援向量儲存區的其實不是 Semantic Kernel 本身。

cues.en: It's just a NuGet package that the semantic kernel repo owns that have that support.
cues.zh: 它只是 Semantic Kernel 儲存庫所管理的一個 NuGet 套件，由這個套件提供相關支援。

cues.en: So it's only in namespace only that they support it while the others don't.
cues.zh: 所以所謂只有 Semantic Kernel 支援、另外兩者不支援，其實只是在名稱與歸屬上如此。

cues.en: But in real life you will still use this part over in agent framework or in extensions AI if you use that for it.
cues.zh: 實際使用 Agent Framework 或 Extensions.AI 時，仍然會使用這部分功能。

cues.en: If we need to give some props to each one of them what is they better at than any of the others?
cues.zh: 如果要各自說說優點，它們分別在哪些方面勝過其他框架呢？

cues.en: Well semantic kernel is better at setting reasoning effort on LLMs. So which if you for example have chat GPT-5 you need to
cues.zh: Semantic Kernel 比較擅長設定 LLM 的推理強度。例如使用 GPT-5 時，需要

cues.en: set between minimal, low, medium or high in reasoning effort and it has a nice little thing on your agent that you can just
cues.zh: 把推理強度設定為 minimal、low、medium 或 high，而它在代理程式上提供了方便的設定，直接

cues.en: set that value.
cues.zh: 指定這個值即可。

cues.en: Neither extensions AI or agent framework have this.
cues.zh: Extensions.AI 與 Agent Framework 都沒有提供這種便利設定。

cues.en: So for that reason technically semantic kernel is better at setting them.
cues.zh: 因此嚴格來說，Semantic Kernel 在設定這項參數時比較好用。

cues.en: All of the three can do it but it's just better.
cues.zh: 三個框架其實都做得到，只是它的做法比較方便。

cues.en: It's more cumbersome over here.
cues.zh: 另外兩者則比較繁瑣。

cues.en: Extensions AI is better in embeddings because it's the only one who can do it as such.
cues.zh: Extensions.AI 在嵌入向量方面比較好，因為只有它本身能提供這項功能。

cues.en: So I don't really know if you can make it better by being the only one who can.
cues.zh: 不過，只因為它是唯一能做的，就說它比較好，好像也有點奇怪。

cues.en: While agent framework is better at chats it's more concise than agent framework and because of the system information you can put directly on
cues.zh: Agent Framework 則更擅長對話，寫法比 Semantic Kernel 精簡，而且可以直接把系統資訊放在

cues.en: agents it's easier.
cues.zh: 代理程式上，因此更容易使用。

cues.en: It's better at agents.
cues.zh: 它也更擅長處理代理程式。

cues.en: The agents are much more evolved than semantic kernels.
cues.zh: 它的代理程式比 Semantic Kernel 的版本成熟許多。

cues.en: It's better at workflows.
cues.zh: 工作流程方面也更好。

cues.en: It's a new version of the workflow and the identic workflow is the only one that that is over here.
cues.zh: 這是新版的工作流程實作，而且只有它提供代理式工作流程。

cues.en: When it comes to LLMs extensions AI and agent framework are exactly the same because they both leverage that anything that supports an iChat
cues.zh: 在 LLM 支援方面，Extensions.AI 與 Agent Framework 完全相同，因為只要某個服務支援 IChatClient，

cues.en: client it can support and that's virtually everything out there.
cues.zh: 它們就能使用，而幾乎所有服務都支援。

cues.en: Semantic kernel has its own connectors which is a problem of course because if new features come along they need to implement it instead
cues.zh: Semantic Kernel 則有自己的連接器。這當然會造成問題，因為每當出現新功能，它們都必須自行實作，無法

cues.en: of just leveraging the raw clients like the two others do.
cues.zh: 像另外兩者一樣直接使用原生用戶端。

cues.en: But they do support OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, Google, offline modes which is also of
cues.zh: 不過，它確實支援 OpenAI、Azure OpenAI、AI Foundry、Google，以及離線模型。這些當然也都

cues.en: course supported by the two others and they have a sort of connection to Cloud.
cues.zh: 受到另外兩者支援，而它也有某種程度的 Claude 連接支援。

cues.en: So unless you're using the OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, I would be more worried sticking with semantic kernel in having those.
cues.zh: 因此，如果使用的不是 OpenAI 或 Azure OpenAI，我會比較擔心繼續留在 Semantic Kernel 上的支援情況。

cues.en: So that's everything I have for you in terms of comparison.
cues.zh: 關於這三者的比較，我想介紹的就是這些。

cues.en: I'm definitely gonna stick with agent framework.
cues.zh: 我自己一定會繼續使用 Agent Framework。

cues.en: I find extensions AI too low level, too much extra work here and there compared to
cues.zh: 我覺得 Extensions.AI 太底層了，和 Agent Framework 相比，許多地方都需要額外處理，

cues.en: what agent framework can do.
cues.zh: 而 Agent Framework 已經把這些事情做好。

cues.en: And on top of that it gives all the nice workflows as well.
cues.zh: 此外，它還提供了很棒的工作流程功能。

cues.en: And semantic kernel I see it as a legacy product now that agent framework will supersede in every way.
cues.zh: 至於 Semantic Kernel，在我看來已經是舊產品，Agent Framework 將會在各方面取代它。

cues.en: I think there's one thing with Amazon Bedrock agents that are not supported yet in agent framework but beyond that it can do everything
cues.zh: 我記得 Amazon Bedrock 代理程式有一項功能，目前 Agent Framework 還不支援，但除此之外，Semantic Kernel 能做的，

cues.en: that semantic kernel could do.
cues.zh: 它幾乎都做得到。

cues.en: Say for the vector stores of course which again is just a namespace only that is there.
cues.zh: 當然，向量儲存區是例外，但前面也說過，那其實只是套件歸屬與命名上的差別。

cues.en: So that is the only place I will ever use a NuGet package going forward and I will be migrating all my semantic kernel over to agent framework which in turn then
cues.zh: 所以未來我只有在向量儲存區這部分會使用那個 NuGet 套件，也會把所有 Semantic Kernel 程式遷移到 Agent Framework，而後者

cues.en: just use the extensions AI behind the scenes for the low level stuff.
cues.zh: 則會在底層使用 Extensions.AI，處理低階功能。

cues.en: So that's everything.
cues.zh: 這次的內容就是這些。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
